next.reason: 1985 REWRITE GR3: released record no longer in the record area unless the file is in a SAME RECORD AREA clause, and then also a record of the other files in it. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR6 restates it ('is no longer available in the record area unless file-name-1 or the file-name associated with record-name-1 is specified in a SAME RECORD AREA clause'; file-name-1 is 2023-only syntax); §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 repeats the unavailability; §2023:12.4.6.4.4 GR2 states the sharing. Same.
